matches.rationale: Finding 2 directly identifies that Proposition 2.1's Ext-symmetry only holds under locally-free hypotheses but is being applied to arbitrary A-modules in Eq. (3.2), which is precisely the ground-truth claim that Jacobian-type algebras lack the required Ext-symmetry in general. Findings 4 and 5 trace the same root defect ('unjustifiably generalized from Proposition 2.1' / 'invalid unrestricted Ext-duality') as it propagates into Theorem 3.2, so they detect the same underlying Section 2 flaw at different downstream locations (R3). None of the findings address the second half of the ground truth concerning nilpotency relations for loops, but the core Ext-symmetry mechanism is clearly caught.
